chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from Muhammad b. Isa b. Ubayd, from Yunus b. Abd al-Rahman, from al-Hasan b. Ziyad, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon him), that he said:
Surely, Allah -- Blessed and Exalted -- chose Islam as your religion, so beautify its company with generosity and beautiful character.

key_terms.الإسلام: Islam -- the religion of submission to God's will
key_terms.السخاء: Sakha' -- generosity, open-handedness, willingness to give freely
key_terms.حسن الخلق: Husn al-khuluq -- beautiful character, good morals, excellent conduct
key_terms.صحبته: Suhbatahu -- its companionship; treating Islam as a companion one adorns

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Sadiq say about beautifying Islam with generosity and good character?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that since Allah chose Islam as the religion for the believers, they should honor and adorn their practice of Islam through two essential qualities: generosity (sakha') and good character (husn al-khuluq). This was recorded in the scholarly gathering of Sheikh al-Saduq in 368 AH, emphasizing that outward religious identity must be matched by inner moral refinement.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
